PolicyApp.title: Agent policies
PolicyApp.hint: Set the world ceiling and tighten your own agent permissions.
PolicyApp.ceilingHint: Only a GM can edit the world ceiling.
PolicyApp.ownerHint: You may tighten the world ceiling. Choices that would loosen it are unavailable. Code always requires approval.
PolicyApp.folderHint: Select folders for each agent class. An empty selection allows all folders. Use Command/Ctrl to select more than one.
PolicyApp.limitsHint: Calls per minute (1–10000). Destructive and code calls use the write limit. Per-agent overrides are preserved.
PolicyApp.invalid: Policies were not saved. Check the choices, folder selections, rate limits and your current permissions, then try again.

Packs.Sealed: Register tool packs in the agentGateway.registerPacks hook before ready.

gatewayUrl.name: Gateway URL
gatewayUrl.hint: WebSocket address of the Agent Gateway this client connects to.

gatewayUrlOverride.hint: WebSocket address of the Agent Gateway this client connects to. Leave empty to use the address your GM set for this world.

defaultGatewayUrl.name: Default gateway URL
defaultGatewayUrl.hint: The wss:// address players in this world connect to, for example wss://gw.example.com/link. A player's own Gateway URL setting overrides it. Leave empty for a gateway on this computer.

pairingToken.name: Pairing token
pairingToken.hint: Token issued when this client was paired with the gateway.

pairingCredential.name: Pairing credential
pairingCredential.hint: Token and gateway address issued when this client was paired.

includeOtherModuleData.name: Include other modules' data
includeOtherModuleData.hint: Allow agents to read data that other modules store on documents.

playerAgentsEnabled.name: Enable player agents
playerAgentsEnabled.hint: Allow AI agents acting as non-GM users to use tools. Off until a GM turns it on.

headlessAgentsEnabled.name: Enable headless agents
headlessAgentsEnabled.hint: Allow headless AI agents (running without a person at the browser) to use tools. Off until a GM turns it on.

worldPolicy.name: World policy
worldPolicy.hint: The GM's ceiling per agent class and tool category. Owners can only tighten it.

folderAllowlist.name: Folder allowlist
folderAllowlist.hint: Folders agents may read, per agent class. Empty means no restriction.

rateLimits.name: Rate limits
rateLimits.hint: How many read and write calls an agent may make per minute, per agent class, with optional per-agent overrides.

ownerPolicy.name: Owner policy
ownerPolicy.hint: Your own policy for your agents. It can only be stricter than the world policy.

Policy.playerAgentsDisabled: Player agents are turned off in this world. A GM must turn on "{setting}" in the Agent Gateway settings.
Policy.headlessAgentsDisabled: Headless agents are turned off in this world. A GM must turn on "{setting}" in the Agent Gateway settings.
Policy.denied: The policy denies {category} tools for this agent.
Policy.approvalRequired: approval required: the {approver} must approve this {category} action, and approval is not available yet.
Policy.unknownCategory: The policy cannot classify the tool "{tool}", so it is denied.

Approvals.pending: Approval is pending (id {id}). Call approval_status with this id to check the outcome.
Approvals.expired: The approval request expired before anyone answered.
Approvals.tooMany: Too many approvals are already pending for this agent. Wait for them to be answered.
Approvals.notFound: No approval with that id exists for this agent.
Approvals.policyChanged: The policy changed since the request was made.
Approvals.mismatch: The approved call no longer matches the request, so it was not run.
Approvals.statusRunning: Approval {id} was approved and the call is still running.

Link.pairingInvalid: The pairing code was not accepted. Check the code printed by the gateway and try again.
Link.pairingRequired: This gateway has not issued a pairing token to this client. Enter the pairing code printed by the gateway.
Link.replaced: This world is connected from another tab or window. Press Connect to use this one instead.
Link.codeRequired: Enter the pairing code printed by the gateway.

RateLimit.exceeded: Rate limit reached: this agent may make {limit} {bucket} calls per minute. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

Pairing.title: Agent Gateway pairing

menu.name: Pair with gateway
menu.label: Pair with gateway
menu.hint: Connect this client to an Agent Gateway using the code it printed.

Invite.label: Invite
Invite.hint: Paste the invite your GM or the gateway operator sent you. It sets the address and connects in one step. A bare code also works.
Invite.invalid: That is not a valid invite. Paste the whole invite exactly as you received it, or ask for a new one.

Server.line: This is a shared gateway. Ask your GM or the gateway operator for an invite, and send them your ids with the button below.
Server.pairingRequired: This gateway has not issued a token to this client. Ask your GM or the gateway operator for an invite and paste it above.
Server.pairingInvalid: The invite was not accepted. It may have expired or been used. Ask for a new invite and try again.
Server.codeRequired: Paste the invite from your GM or the gateway operator.

Address.inherited: Gateway: {address} (your GM's default for this world)
Address.unreachable: Can't reach the gateway at {address}. Check the address and that the gateway is running.
Address.invalid: That gateway address is not valid. Use an address like wss://gw.example.com/link, with no # part and no user name.
Address.worldInvalid: The default gateway URL for this world is not a valid wss:// address, so it is ignored.

Pairing.codeHint: The code the gateway printed when it started.

CopyIds.label: Your ids: world {world}, user {user}
CopyIds.hint: On a shared gateway, send these two ids to the operator. They create a one-time invite for exactly this world and user; enter that invite above as the pairing code.
CopyIds.copied: Copied. Send it to the gateway operator.
CopyIds.failed: Could not copy. Select the ids above and copy them by hand.

Audit.title: Agent Gateway Audit

menu.name: Audit log
menu.label: Open audit log
menu.hint: Review what agents changed and undo it. Only a GM can see or undo entries.

Audit.empty: No agent changes have been recorded.
Audit.relayedNoUndo: Made by a player's agent. No GM witnessed this change, so it cannot be undone.
Audit.undoStopped: Undo stopped after restoring {count} document(s). The entry stays open.
Audit.undoSkipped: {count} document(s) cannot be undone and were left as they are.
Audit.undoFailed: Undo failed for {count} document(s). The entry stays open; see the console.
Audit.undoBusy: This entry is reserved for undo. Wait for the other GM or refresh the log. If undo was interrupted, a GM must inspect the entry and world changes before manually removing its reservation page.
Audit.undoRefused: Only a GM can undo an entry, and an entry can be undone once.

conflict.title: Changed since the agent's call
conflict.body: These documents changed after the agent's call. Undoing will overwrite those later changes. Continue?

OfflineEvents.title: Offline event reading
OfflineEvents.hint: Allow paired agents with an allowed read policy to read previously observed events while this world is offline. This gateway uses the last policy it received. Purge deletes this world’s buffered events from the connected gateway.

AGENT_GATEWAY.ApprovalDialog.title: Agent approval requests
AGENT_GATEWAY.ApprovalDialog.unavailable: Current document unavailable or not visible. Review the full arguments below.
AGENT_GATEWAY.ApprovalDialog.reasonRequi: Enter a reason before denying this request.
AGENT_GATEWAY.ApprovalDialog.tooLarge: Request exceeds safe review limits. Deny it and ask the agent for a smaller request.
AGENT_GATEWAY.Consent.title: Agent Gateway consent code
AGENT_GATEWAY.Consent.prompt: {client} is asking to connect to Foundry as you. If that was you, type this code on its page:
AGENT_GATEWAY.Consent.hint: If you did not start this, ignore it. Nothing is shared until the code is entered.
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.title: Agent Gateway connected apps
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.menu.name: Connected apps
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.menu.label: Connected apps
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.menu.hint: See the AI apps you have allowed to act as you, and revoke their access.
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.intro: These apps can act as you. Revoking one signs it out at once.
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.offline: Connect to the gateway first, then open this window again.
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.tooOld: This gateway is too old to list connected apps. Update the gateway.
AGENT_GATEWAY.Grants.failed: The gateway did not answer. Try again.
